result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, though the crossing distance is substantial. interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
